mentions.name: Poser
mentions.description: Ski technique feedback tool where skiers upload a short ski clip and get analysis results, currently delivered as head-tracking and skeleton overlay videos. Additional built features include an animated 3D body, turn detection, and balance, steering, pressure, and edging metrics. Skier tracking and pose estimation use Meta AI's SAM3 Tracking and SAM3D Body, with heavy processing on Runpod.
mentions.problem: Skiers want to improve their ski technique and skills
